paper_id: Wang et al. - 2024 - TransformLoc Transforming MAVs into Mobile Localization Infrastructures in Heterogeneous Swarms
title: TransformLoc: Transforming MAVs into Mobile Localization Infrastructures in Heterogeneous Swarms
motivation: BMAVs积累定位误差，现有方案需要基础设施或重算力，灾区快速响应场景无法满足
problem_framing: 将AMAV资源分配给BMAV的耦合优化问题，含误差未知与动态调度
key_insight: 把AMAV变成移动定位基础设施，用视觉观测修正BMAV累积误差
method_signature: 误差感知联合估计+近邻自适应分组调度
evaluation_criteria: ATE绝对轨迹误差、导航成功率
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 系统要求AMAV自身定位误差小于10cm，需LiDAR等高端传感器辅助
evidence_for_taste: turning this insight into a practical system is non-trivial
making it too complicated to run on MAVs
eliminate the necessity of having the actual locations
The communication load is deemed manageable
thinking_moves: 将异构MAV资源差异转化为定位基础设施复用的机会
用协方差矩阵trace替代真实定位误差实现无参考推断
用Voronoi图将多对多资源分配拆解为多个一对多子问题
用δ步前瞻搜索树实现非短视调度
